name: Basilisk

source.note: The 2024 Basilisk (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block). Petrifying Gaze is a Bonus Action; its second-failure Petrified stage is a rider the engine does not run (the first stage, Restrained, does).

bonus_actions.name: Petrifying Gaze

params.when: end of the target's next turn if it is still Restrained

bonus_actions.summary: Recharge 4-6. A 30-ft cone: DC 12 Con save or Restrained; a second failed save turns the target to stone.
bonus_actions.text: Constitution saving throw, DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the basilisk can see its own reflection in the Cone, it must make the save too. First failure: Restrained, with a repeat save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on a success. Second failure: Petrified instead of Restrained.

summary: A heavy-jawed lizard whose gaze roots a victim in place and then turns it to stone.
